resources.string: Before keeping records, read this notice and the complete Privacy Policy and User Agreement, then make an explicit choice.
LiZhang stores the contacts, gift records and reminders you enter or import on this device. No account, ads or cloud sync are provided, and the app does not upload this data.

Contacts are read for preview, selection and deduplication only after you request import and grant permission. Notification permission is requested when you enable reminders. Both permissions are optional for bookkeeping.

CSV, Excel and ordinary backups are unencrypted; password encryption is optional for backups. Restore replaces contacts and gift records rather than merging them. Backups exclude reminders and settings. Keep files and passwords secure.
See the full text for operator details, version, effective date and publication status. In-app consent and operator approval for publication are separate records.
Agree to the policy and agreement and continue

Return to read and choose again, or exit LiZhang. No contact or notification permission is requested here, and existing ledgers will be kept.
